name: med-education-lite
description: Token-conscious lecture, transcript, study-document and exam-question skills with source-first answers.

interface.shortDescription: Lecture-to-study pipeline with less repeated context
interface.longDescription: Six focused skills for RAW Markdown, question-only Word, polished page-tagged transcripts, PDF and editable Word study notes, Obsidian explanations and single-question answers. Local indexing, bounded evidence packets and deterministic builders reduce repeated input and generation.
defaultPrompt: pdf-to-rawmd로 이 강의자료를 원문과 실제 그림을 보존한 RAW MD로 변환해줘.
transcript-pdf-study로 녹음정제 PART 2와 강의록·기출을 반영한 PDF와 Word 정리본을 만들어줘.
yama-question-answer로 이 한 문항을 강의록과 Script 근거부터 찾아 설명해줘.
